# Nivin Xavier

> Entrepreneur and marketer since the 8th grade. Data-driven digital marketing, analytics, and brand-building consultant with fifteen years of experience across startups to the Fortune 500. Founder of OmniVue AI, Atlantic Blinds, LifeSpace Blinds, and the Canada Global Export Council. Based in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada.

Positioning: Creativity, backed by data. Growth you can count. Nivin pairs conversion copywriting and brand strategy with a rigorous analytics and measurement stack, which is a rare combination of right-brain creativity and left-brain rigor in one operator.

## Headline results
- 6662% organic e-commerce revenue growth for the e-commerce division of a billion-dollar global car manufacturer
- 521% organic traffic growth on the same engagement
- 331% paid revenue growth
- Over 10 million words written across technology, health, finance, and marketing
- Scaled a digital agency team from 2 to over 90 people
- Built and exited two brands; took one startup from idea to acquisition

## Services
- [Growth and Digital Strategy](https://unlittered.com/#work): SEO, SEM, paid social, email, and conversion rate optimization as one system
- [Analytics and Transformation](https://unlittered.com/#work): Google Analytics, server-side Google Tag Manager, attribution, cookie-less measurement
- [Brand and Conversion Copywriting](https://unlittered.com/#work): websites, landing pages, ads, and content marketing
- [Product and Project Leadership](https://unlittered.com/#work): idea to R&D to go-to-market, Scrum and Agile
- [Team Building and Talent](https://unlittered.com/#work): scouting and leading top technical talent
- [Founder Advisory](https://unlittered.com/#work): strategy, positioning, partnerships, operations
